title: Binding a chat to its lane
summary: A chat is nudged only when it is bound: a line LANE|ADAPTER|CHAT or LANE|PRINCIPAL|ADAPTER|CHAT in etc/nudge.conf or var/nudge.local.conf. CHAT is the conversation path (/c/<id> on chatgpt.com, /chat/<uuid> on claude.ai), which never changes, or its title. Tom binds with the address from his browser: mailnudge.rex bind LANE https://chatgpt.com/c/<id>. Lane * binds a chat to every lane not bound by name for that principal (the coordinator: bind '*' URL COORDINATOR). mailnudge.rex unbound lists lanes with mail waiting and no chat bound.
invariants: A chat cannot see its own address, so it cannot bind itself: ask Tom, giving your lane id.
Bindings are checked: lane ids, principals, paths of letters, digits, / - _ only, https chatgpt.com or claude.ai addresses only.
Claude Code cloud sessions (claude.ai/code/...) have no adapter yet and cannot be nudged.
